value.rationale: This is a natural complete automorphism-group classification for the simplest binary system of at most two particles. It isolates a precise difference between residual finiteness and local residual finiteness (indeed local virtual abelianness) at exactly quadratic language complexity without introducing a full-shift auxiliary factor. The structural calculation is motivated by recent theorems relating periodic-point density and automorphism-group finiteness, not an arbitrary small enumeration.
